goal_intent: book a long table for eight and ask for it to be away from the door

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling because I’d like to book a long table for a little get-together we’re planning—it’s shaping up to be quite the reunion!
Thank you! There will be eight of us altogether—everyone’s really looking forward to catching up over a nice meal.
Oh, a private room sounds perfect for us—thanks for explaining how it works! We’d like to book it for this Saturday at 7:30pm, if that’s available.
That all sounds great, thank you! If possible, could we please have the table set away from the door? A quieter spot would really suit the group. Other than that, I think we’re all sorted!
That’s perfect, thank you so much for your help! I’m all set, so I’m happy to end the call here. [END OF CALL]
